title: vybn.receipt.v1
description: An answer that carries its own receipts. Every load-bearing claim is bound to evidence a cheap machine can check: exact source bytes by hash and byte span. The machine verifies integrity; the reader judges whether the span supports the claim. Verification must cost less than generation. That asymmetry is the point.

uri.description: where the source bytes live; pin to immutable content (e.g. a commit-pinned raw URL)

sha256.description: digest of the entire source byte string

span.description: byte offsets [start, end) of the cited passage inside the source

span_sha256.description: digest of exactly the span bytes

bytes_b64.description: inline source bytes, base64; when present the verifier needs no network

membrane.description: why every cited byte is safe to carry
